name: Solidbodies Research
description: A research company that holds Geldan in a web of favors and sends her to spy on its rival at Uthros.

description_citations.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
description_citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Velmenon tells Geldan that Solidbodies will trade her to someone else if she does not take another job.
timeline.quote: There's nothing else you can do for us, Geldan. It's this or trading you in for something from someone else.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Velmenon explains that Solidbodies is behind its rival the Uthros Combine and offers Geldan freedom from her debt if she gets into the Uthros facility.
timeline.quote: If you can get in, you will be free.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Rezint reveals that the Solidbodies gear includes modules that seem to measure the wearers, which unsettles him.
timeline.quote: I think a few of them are measuring us.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Geldan schemes to wear the vests but then sell the data to a competitor, noting the contract did not forbid it.
timeline.quote: But there was nothing in the contract about exclusivity.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Geldan apologizes to Rezint and disconnects the Solidbodies gear, deciding to keep anything she finds for herself.
timeline.quote: She's given them everything she owes them.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

relations.note: Velmenon is Geldan's Solidbodies Research contact.
relations.quote: Geldan's Solidbodies Research contact, Velmenon, stares at her from across the table.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

relations.note: Geldan works off her debt of favors to Solidbodies.
relations.quote: If you can get in, you will be free.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

relations.note: Geldan breaks from Solidbodies, refusing their pickup.
relations.quote: She won't meet their stupid ship—not until she has something better.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

relations.quote: It is the primary competitor of Solidbodies Research
